steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: Comparison involves identifying similarities and differences between texts, considering perspectives, methods, and how writers convey their viewpoints. | : Write about both texts in each paragraph, using comparative connectives to link them. | Examiner's Tip: You must compare BOTH perspectives AND methods. Use evidence from both texts equally. Spend about 20-25 minutes on this question. | Comparison Exam Strategy: This is AQA Paper 2 Q4 (16 marks) - spend 20-25 minutes. You must compare BOTH perspectives AND methods. Use an integrated approach: write about both texts in every paragraph, using comparative connectives (however, similarly, whereas, in contrast).
